_notes: E1 - Weekly regular-rate averaging. E1 PICKER ONE works Mon 5 h on E1 JOB HIGH (35), Tue 10 h on E1 JOB LOW (20) and Wed 5 h on HIGH, all in one Mon-Wed transfer.
Weekly regular rate = straight-time pay / gross hours: (175 + 200 + 175) / 20 = 27.5. Method entireRate prices overtime hours at 1.5 x that average.
Tue: 8 h regular x 20 + 2 h x 1.5 x 27.5 = 242.50. The contrast 570 is the overtime at the job's own rate (method None).
The one-day re-price of an earlier day (catalog step 3) is deferred as a product gap (WEBPET-3158) and lives in manual case E1-03.
The Monday is the one in days -12..-6, computed at run time. cleanup is empty by design: the flow sweeps per day itself.
